rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for copying a model, pattern, appearance, or behavior.

example.english: I imitate my teacher's handwriting all the time.
example.traditional: 我成日模仿老師嘅筆跡。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sing4 jat6 mou4 fong2 lou5 si1 ge3 bat1 zik1

rows.note: Use this when imitating a person's manner, voice, or behavior, often with a playful or mocking implication.

example.english: You always imitate the way I talk!
example.jyutping: nei5 sing4 jat6 baan6 ngo5 gong2 je5 gaa3 wo3

rows.note: Use this construction when following a particular model, example, or pattern to make something in the same way.

example.english: I imitate the way it is done in the demo video, and I finally got it right.
example.traditional: 我照住示範片入面個樣做，終於整到喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu3 zyu6 si6 faan6 pin3 jap6 min6 go3 joeng2 zou6 zung1 jyu1 zing2 dou3 laa3
